Name: The Learning Channel
Author: CozyPsychologist
Description:
[center] [b][u][size=5] The Learning Channel[/size][/u][/b][/center]
[size=4]
The Learning Channel adds a new educational TV station to Stardew Valley where you can test your knowledge across eight different subjects. Choose a topic, answer the question of the day, learn something new, and—if you want—earn a little gold for getting it right.[/size]
[size=4]
The channel is inspired by the warm, curious feeling of classic educational television: colorful, welcoming, and built around the idea that learning should be fun.[/size]

[size=5][b][u]Features[/u][/b][/size]

[size=4]A different question for every day of the year[/size]
[size=4]Four possible answers for every question[/size]
[size=4]Educational explanations after each answer[/size]
[size=4]Correct and incorrect feedback[/size]
[size=4]Eight subjects[/size]
[size=4]Optional daily gold rewards[/size]
[size=4]Rewards can be earned once per subject per day[/size]
[size=4]Configurable reward amount[/size]
[size=4]Individual subjects can be enabled or disabled[/size]
[size=4]Broad international coverage rather than focusing only on Western history and culture[/size]


[b][u][size=5]Subjects[/size][/u][/b]

[size=5][b]History[/b][/size]
[size=4]Explore human history from the ancient world through the modern era.[/size][size=4]Questions include ancient civilizations, empires, trade, revolutions, industrialization, colonialism, independence movements, world conflicts, political change, and social history.[/size][size=4] Coverage includes Africa, Asia, Europe, the Americas, the Middle East, and the Pacific.[/size]

[b][size=5]Science[/size][/b]
[size=4]Physics, chemistry, astronomy, scientific reasoning, measurement, technology, and major discoveries.
Questions range from basic scientific principles to applied concepts involving energy, matter, forces, chemical reactions, space, experimentation, and scientific methodology.[/size]

[b][size=5]Literature[/size][/b]
[size=4]Test your knowledge of authors, novels, poetry, drama, literary traditions, and literary techniques.The question bank includes literature from Africa, Asia, Europe, Latin America, the Middle East, North America, and classical literary traditions.[/size]

[b][size=5]Art & Music[/size][/b]
[size=4]A combined exploration of visual art and music from around the world.
Topics include: painting, sculpture, architecture, artistic movements, indigenous and traditional art, music history, instruments, musical forms, rhythm and melody, global musical traditions, European classical alongside African, Asian, Indigenous, Latin American, Middle Eastern, and other artistic traditions.[/size]

[size=5][b]Natural Science[/b][/size]
[size=4]Focused on the living world and the Earth itself.
Topics include: Biology, Genetics, Evolution, Zoology, Botany, Microbiology, Ecology, Adaptation, Geology, Paleontology, Earth systems.[/size]

[b][size=5]Philosophy[/size][/b]
[size=4]Explore some of humanity's biggest questions.
Topics include ethics, knowledge, logic, metaphysics, political philosophy, the mind, free will, and major philosophical traditions. Includes Greek and Roman philosophy alongside Chinese, Indian, Buddhist, Islamic, African, Latin American, Japanese, and other philosophical traditions.[/size]

[b][size=5]Mythology & Folklore[/size][/b]
[size=4]Gods, monsters, heroes, tricksters, legends, spirits, and stories from cultures around the world.
Traditions include Greek, Roman, Egyptian, Mesopotamian, Norse, Celtic, Slavic, South Asian, Chinese, Japanese, African, Mesoamerican, Polynesian, Indigenous North American, Caribbean, Latin American, and many others. [/size]

[b][size=5]Food & Culture[/size][/b]
[size=4]Food is about much more than recipes.
Questions explore Traditional dishes, Staple ingredients, Cooking techniques, Food preservation, Agriculture, Trade, Culinary history, Dining customs, Festivals, Drinks, Communal meals, Cultural traditions[/size]

[b][size=5]How It Works[/size][/b]
[size=4]1.Turn on your television and select The Learning Channel.[/size]
[size=4]
2. Choose the subject you want to study and you'll receive that subject's question for the current day.[/size]
[size=4]
3. Each question has four possible answers.[/size]
[size=4]
4. Answer correctly and you'll receive feedback explaining the answer. [/size]

[size=4]5. Answer incorrectly and, by default, the channel will tell you the correct answer and explain why.[/size]

[b][size=5]Daily Subject Rewards[/size][/b]
[size=4]By default, answering a question correctly awards [b]500g[/b].
Rewards are tracked separately for every subject.
You can earn the reward once from each subject per day (configurable).[/size]
[size=4]
Repeating the same subject does not award the money again that day.
You can continue answering questions even after receiving the reward.
Don't want trivia to affect your farm economy? The reward system can be disabled completely.[/size]

[b][size=5]Rewards[/size][/b]
[size=4]Enable Daily Subject Rewards
Default: On
Turns the gold reward system on or off. When disabled, the quizzes continue to function normally.
Reward Amount
Default: 500g
Available values:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]0g[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]100g[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]250g[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]500g[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]1000g[/size][/*]
[/list][heading][size=5]Configurable Subjects[/size][/heading]
[size=4]Every subject can be individually enabled or disabled.[/size]

[size=4]Disabled subjects are removed from the channel's subject menu entirely.
Want a channel devoted only to History, Literature, and Philosophy? You can do that.[/size]

[size=5][b][u]FAQ's[/u][/b][/size]

[size=4]Q: When do the broadcasts air?
A: There's a new one for every subject every day.

Q: What happens if I don't watch an episode?
A: The valley does not offer streaming services. You are at the mercy of the airwaves. If you miss it you miss it. 
 
Q: Can I install the mod mid-save?
A: Yes. The broadcasts will align with wherever you're at in your save.  

Q: Will the broadcasts eventually repeat?
A: The question pool is pretty robust, it shouldn't repeat until every question has been seen by the player per subject. 

Q: Was this mod made with AI?
A: No, I researched these questions and coordinated with several faculty friends of mine. No AI was used for coding.  [/size]
